outline.subject: HMS Warrior was a light aircraft carrier that served in the British Royal Navy, the Royal Canadian Navy, and the Argentine Navy.

sections.title: HMS Warrior ( R31 )
sections.covers: This section provides an overview of the ship's construction, service history with different navies, and eventual disposal.

sections.title: Description
sections.covers: This section details the physical specifications, armament, radar equipment, and design features of the aircraft carrier.

sections.title: Construction and career
sections.covers: This section describes the ship's construction, its loan to the Royal Canadian Navy, and its subsequent return to the Royal Navy.

sections.title: Royal Navy service
sections.covers: This section covers the ship's refits, experimental trials, deployments during the Korean War, and participation in nuclear testing.

sections.title: Argentine Navy service
sections.covers: This section details the ship's acquisition by Argentina, its operational history as ARA Independencia, and its final decommissioning and scrapping.
